card.name: Travel-guide descriptions of places and landmarks
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'the', 'a' or 'with', and adjectives like 'moderate' or 'scenic', in travel-guide or encyclopedia text describing a place, landmark or sight. They come just before the descriptive noun.

modes.label: Article before superlative or key noun
modes.description: 'the' or 'a' leading into a landmark, a most-popular claim or a description of a town.
modes.example: the convent is perhaps<< the>> most popular Christian pilgrimage destination in Syria.

modes.label: Descriptive adjective about a sight
modes.description: An adjective that rates the size or appeal of a sight.
modes.example: This is regarded as one of the most<< scenic>> train rides in North America
